full_prompt_en: A square black-and-white science-fiction illustration shows a young adult woman in a fitted dark armored suit, seen from a low viewpoint. She stands toward the left center, torso turned slightly away while her head rotates back to look downward toward the viewer. A straight black bob frames her pale face, with blunt bangs just above large shaded eyes. Her lips are slightly parted and her expression is cool and alert. The glossy suit follows the chest, waist, arms, and hips with segmented panels, narrow seams, rounded shoulder armor, and small hard fittings. A belt and complex equipment sit at the hips; a long dark mechanical object rises behind the left side of her body. One gloved arm hangs straight down near the bottom edge. Behind her, an industrial interior tilts diagonally: broad pale bands cut across the upper half, while densely drafted panels, pipes, vents, and mechanical recesses fill the gray walls. The camera angle enlarges her upper body and makes the architecture slope behind her, giving the static pose latent motion. Strong ink blacks establish the hair and suit. Fine crosshatching, dots, and tight parallel lines model reflective armor and the machinery, while smooth light areas leave the face and ceiling readable. The image remains almost completely grayscale, with only subtle warm gray in a few passages. The top edge crops some ceiling, and the lower edge cuts the figure below the hips; no floor is visible. No readable lettering appears in the selected scene. Its visual language joins manga-style facial simplification with intricate technical drawing, high-contrast ink work, and an unusually photographic sense of material shine.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形黑白科幻插画从低视点描绘一位穿合身深色装甲服的年轻女子。她站在偏左中央，躯干略向外转，头却回望并俯视观者。齐整黑色短发框住浅色面孔，平直刘海停在有阴影的大眼睛上方。嘴唇微张，神情冷静而警觉。发亮的服装沿胸、腰、臂和臀分布分段面板、窄拼缝、圆肩甲及小硬质扣件。腰带和复杂设备装在髋部；一件长而深色的机械物从身体左侧后方升起。一条戴手套的手臂直垂至下缘附近。背后的工业内部呈斜角：宽阔浅色横带切过上半部，密画面板、管线、通风口及机械凹槽布满灰墙。镜头角度放大她的上半身，使建筑在背后倾斜，给静姿注入潜在动势。浓黑墨块确立发与服装。细交叉排线、点与紧密平行线表现反光装甲及机器，平滑浅区让脸和顶棚可辨。图像几乎完全灰阶，只有少量暖灰变化。上缘裁去部分顶棚，下缘在髋部以下截断人物，看不到地面。选定画面没有可读字母。视觉语言把漫画式面部简化与精密技术制图、高对比墨色，以及近乎摄影般的材料反光结合。
style_prompt_en: The monochrome science-fiction rendering joins clean manga contours with very fine industrial draftsmanship. Solid blacks anchor rounded glossy volumes; dense parallel hatching and tiny panel lines turn adjacent gray fields into mechanical detail. A low, oblique viewpoint makes broad structural bands cut diagonally behind a tall central silhouette. Pale smooth areas are reserved for focal features, while reflective seams and hard fittings catch narrow highlights. The composition is tightly cropped and contrasty, with little open space except bright strips in the upper structure. Facial forms remain comparatively simple and soft against the intricate armored and architectural textures. Ink, screen-tone gray, and subtle grain produce a crisp printed feel, while controlled sheen gives the dark surfaces physical weight. The mood is cool, tense, and technically precise.
style_prompt_zh: 单色科幻绘制结合清洁漫画轮廓与极细工业制图。整块浓黑稳住圆润发亮的体积；密集平行排线与微小面板线把相邻灰域化作机械细节。低斜视点让宽阔结构带在高耸中央剪影后斜切。平滑浅色留给焦点特征，反光拼缝与硬扣件接住狭窄高光。构图紧密裁切而对比强，上方结构中的亮带之外少有空处。相对于繁密的装甲和建筑纹理，面部形状较简单柔和。墨线、网点灰与细颗粒带来清利印刷感，受控反光则让深色表面有物理重量。气氛冷静、紧绷且技术精确。
theme_en: A short-haired woman in a black armored suit viewed from below inside an industrial chamber
theme_zh: 工业舱室内仰视一位短发、身穿黑色装甲服的女子
name: Gantz
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
